Last updated: 4 November 2026

Your trust is part of every order. This page explains — in plain, honest words — what information we collect when you shop with Fragal Perfumes, why we collect it, who sees it, and how we keep it safe.

This policy covers how Fragal Perfumes (“we”, “us” and “our”) collects and handles your personal data (“Personal Data”) across our website fragalperfumes.pk, our WhatsApp, telephone and email customer service, and the orders you place with us. By visiting our website and/or purchasing something from us, you agree to us handling your Personal Data as described here.

Our store runs on Shopify, the platform on which our website is hosted. This policy covers our own use of your Personal Data; Shopify’s handling of data on its platform is described in Shopify’s privacy policy at www.shopify.com/legal/privacy/customers. This policy is governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.

What We Collect

Personal Data is any information about an individual from which that person can be identified. Information where the identity has been removed — anonymous data — is not Personal Data.

You share with us:

  • Your contact details — your name, delivery address and phone number and, if you give one, your email address.
  • Your order details — the products you order, order numbers, amounts, payment method (cash on delivery), and your delivery, return and exchange history with us.
  • Our conversations — when you contact us with questions or feedback through WhatsApp, SMS, telephone, email or social media (including Facebook, Instagram and TikTok).
  • Your reviews, if you choose to leave a review of a product you have purchased.

Your visit tells us: information collected automatically when you use our website — your device and browser type, IP address, and the pages and products you view or add to your cart. This is collected through cookies and similar technologies (see Cookies below).

Our partners pass on: delivery status updates from our courier partners, so we know where your parcel is.

Why We Collect It

Everything we collect serves your order, or our duty to run this house properly. We use your Personal Data to:

  • Process, confirm and deliver the orders you place with us — including confirming your cash-on-delivery order by WhatsApp, SMS or telephone before dispatch, and sending you tracking updates.
  • Collect payment for your order on delivery.
  • Respond to your questions, requests, returns, exchanges and complaints.
  • Prevent, detect and manage fraud, fake orders and abuse — which may include considering past delivery and return history when confirming cash-on-delivery orders.
  • Comply with our tax, accounting, regulatory and other legal obligations.
  • Send you offers and updates about our products where you have agreed to receive them — you can opt out at any time.
  • Publish product reviews you leave, with the name you provide.
  • Measure and improve our website and our service.
  • Resolve disputes that may arise.

Who Sees Your Information

Only the people who need it to serve you — never anyone else.

The courier delivering your parcel receives your name, delivery address and phone number and, for cash-on-delivery orders, the amount payable. Our courier partners use this information only to deliver your parcel, contact you about the delivery and collect payment on our behalf.

WhatsApp and SMS. We use WhatsApp Business and SMS services to confirm orders and send delivery updates. Messages sent through WhatsApp are processed by WhatsApp in accordance with its own privacy policy.

The platforms behind our store. Shopify (website hosting and order management) and other service providers who process data on our behalf, under contract and only on our instructions.

When the law asks. Government authorities, courts and regulators, where required by law, or where necessary to protect our rights, our customers or the public.

And one promise, plainly: we do not sell your Personal Data.

Keeping It Safe

We make reasonable efforts to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk. Access controls and organisational and technical measures protect your Personal Data against unauthorised access, destruction, loss, alteration or misuse.

If we suspect a Personal Data breach, we have procedures in place to deal with it — and we will notify you and any applicable regulator of a breach where we are legally required to do so.

No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, so a word of care: we will never ask you for a card PIN, wallet PIN or one-time password. Please do not share them with anyone claiming to be from Fragal Perfumes.

How Long We Keep It

We retain your Personal Data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes we collected it for — including satisfying legal, tax and accounting requirements, handling returns, exchanges and refunds, preventing fraud, and establishing or defending legal claims. No longer.

Your Rights

Your information belongs to you. You may ask us to give you access to the Personal Data we hold about you, to correct data that is inaccurate, to delete data that we are not required to keep, or to stop sending you marketing messages. We may need to verify your identity before acting on a request.

To make a request, contact us on WhatsApp at +92 308 4456947 or email info@fragalperfumes.pk.

Cookies

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to keep your cart, remember your preferences and understand how the website is used. You can control cookies through your browser settings; blocking cookies may affect how parts of the website work.

Our website may also carry advertising pixels from Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok and Google. These pixels note details of your visit — such as the pages and products you viewed and what you added to your cart — and that information is used to show you Fragal Perfumes advertising on those platforms. These services process that information under their own privacy policies.

Children

Our website and products are intended for adults. We do not knowingly collect Personal Data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with Personal Data, please contact us and we will delete it.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The current version will always be published on this page with its “Last updated” date. Your continued use of our website after an update means you accept the updated Privacy Policy.

Talk to Us

Questions about this policy, or about your own information? We are a message away — WhatsApp us at +92 308 4456947 or write to info@fragalperfumes.pk, and we will be glad to help.
